purpose: Prove that every meaningful Work Item state change is backed by an append-only Receipt (FR9, FR16, FR17, NFR6): one happy-path chain proposed → approved → in_review → completed, one blocked-path chain proposed → blocked → resumed → failed, and one correction scenario where an erroneous receipt is followed by a NEW correction receipt while the original remains unedited. Receipts here are local contract evidence only; every live tenant mutation stays deferred and receipt-gated.

workItems.com_title: Queue happy-path sample: tenant readiness checklist
workItems.com_summary: Local-contract Work Item used only to prove receipt-backed transitions through proposed → approved → in_review → completed.
workItems.com_rationale: Story 2.3 happy-path sample projected from CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001; final state completed is the last receipt after_state and is local projection only.

workItems.com_title: Queue blocked-path sample: publisher prefix risk
workItems.com_summary: Local-contract Work Item used only to prove receipt-backed transitions through proposed → blocked → resumed (to approved) → failed.
workItems.com_rationale: Story 2.3 blocked-path sample projected from CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001; final state failed is the last receipt after_state and is local projection only.

workItems.com_summary: Local-contract Work Item used only to prove that an erroneous held receipt is corrected by a NEW blocked receipt; the original receipt stays byte-identical.
workItems.com_rationale: Story 2.3 correction sample; final projected state blocked comes from the correction receipt after_state after an erroneous held receipt left priorRecommendedState proposed→held.

receipts.com_decision_rationale: Propose the happy-path queue sample Work Item locally so subsequent receipt-backed transitions have an auditable origin.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human approval (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Human approval moves the happy-path sample from proposed to approved within declared authority; approval is recorded as a Receipt, not an in-place state edit.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human review (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Review opens after approval so output can be assessed before completion; the approved→in_review move is recorded only by appending this Receipt.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human completion acceptance (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Happy-path outcome accepted; in_review → completed is projected only after this completed Receipt is appended.
Propose the blocked-path queue sample so the proposed → blocked → resumed → failed chain is fully receipt-backed.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human block command (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Progress depends on an external dependency (publisher-prefix decision), so the Work Item is blocked via a blocked Receipt rather than a silent state overwrite.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human resume command after dependency resolution (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Dependency cleared; resumed verb projects blocked → approved so work may proceed under declared authority. Resume is a Receipt, not an edit of the block receipt.

receipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 2.3 contract validation of failure recording
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Attempted work could not complete after resume; failed Receipt projects approved → failed and preserves the full prior receipt chain for audit and retry review.
Propose the correction-scenario Work Item so an erroneous later receipt has a valid prior state to reference.

receipts.com_authority_basis: agent suggestion under local contract; later corrected by human (do not edit this receipt)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: ERRONEOUS receipt kept intentionally for audit: the agent mis-classified an external dependency wait as held (human judgment) instead of blocked (dependency). This receipt stays append-only locked and is never edited; correction is a NEW receipt.

receipts.com_authority_basis: explicit human correction of prior receipt CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-ERR-HELD-001 (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Correction: the prior held classification in CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-ERR-HELD-001 was wrong; the wait is an external dependency, so state becomes blocked. The original held receipt remains unchanged and available for audit; this is a NEW append-only Receipt.

correctionScenario.note: Corrections are always new Receipts. CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-ERR-HELD-001 remains byte-identical with com_append_only_locked=true; CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-FIX-BLOCKED-001 references it via correctsReceipt and evidence_refs corrects:CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-ERR-HELD-001.

liveWritesDeferred.deferredUpdate: Applying projected com_state_group completed (and intermediate approved/in_review values) to a live Dataverse Work Item row requires a receipt-gated tenant write; no live tenant write was performed in this slice. Gate: receipts CR-LOCAL-STATE-HAPPY-*.

Applying projected com_state_group failed (and intermediate blocked/approved values) to a live Dataverse Work Item row requires a receipt-gated tenant write; no live tenant write was performed in this slice. Gate: receipts CR-LOCAL-STATE-BLOCK-*.

Applying the corrected com_state_group blocked (after erroneous held) to a live Dataverse Work Item row requires a receipt-gated tenant write of the correction receipt; the erroneous held receipt stays append-only in the ledger. No live tenant write was performed in this slice. Gate: CR-LOCAL-STATE-CORR-FIX-BLOCKED-001.
Persisting the Story 2.3 local receipts into the live com_councilreceipt ledger is receipt-gated tenant write work outside this slice; these receipts are local contract evidence only.
liveWritesDeferred.receiptGate: all CR-LOCAL-STATE-* receipts in this slice
